name: windows-light
steps: const h=window.__sim.host;h.control=h.control.map(v=>({...v,input_state:'ready',lease:null}));for(const view of h.control)h.emit({type:'control_changed',view});h.tasks=h.tasks.map(t=>({...t,state:'completed'}));for(const task of h.tasks)h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task});h.runs=h.runs.map(r=>({...r,state:'completed'}));for(const run of h.runs)h.emit({type:'run_upserted',run});
